protocol_metadata.about: stHYPE is the premiere liquid staking solution for the Hyperliquid L1 network. Users deposit HYPE tokens into stHYPE smart contracts and receive stHYPE tokens in return, which accrue staking rewards while maintaining liquidity for DeFi use. The protocol distributes staked HYPE across a decentralized validator set, is controlled by a multisig with veto rights for stHYPE holders, and operates under an EIP-1967 transparent proxy architecture.
